jobs.title: Online Marketing Manager (Performance/Paid Media Specialist)
jobs.description: Aerogreet is a premium airport concierge company based in Frankfurt am Main, part of a group with over 20 years of experience delivering VIP travel services to high-net-worth clients. We help travelers skip the lines and enjoy a seamless, stress-free airport experience — from arrival to departure — through our digital booking platform, currently available at 950+ airports worldwide. We're growing fast and looking for a hands-on marketing specialist to help us reach more discerning travelers. Tasks Planning, launching, and managing Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max) across different markets Building and refining audience targeting, keyword strategy, and bidding approaches
jobs.why: Focuses on performance marketing for a VIP concierge service, perfect for showcasing creative ad angles, hook analysis, and conversion copy.
jobs.proposal_opener: VIP services demand high-converting, premium ad creative—I write direct-response Meta ad copy and short-form video scripts designed to boost CTR and bookings.
jobs.flags: May expect media buying execution alongside creative work
jobs.summary: This role oversees performance marketing campaigns to drive digital bookings for a VIP airport concierge service. You will optimize paid media ads across channels to acquire high-net-worth travelers.
